_template_notes.purpose: Business invariants — Engine #4 sidecar artifact (KHÔNG bump registry — ADR-cmi-002 Revised). Phase 3 produces per-session DRAFT. Phase 7 CDG ACCEPT → APPEND vào CANONICAL sidecar tại .mc-data/work/wf-cmi/business-invariants.json. Tham chiếu 04-file-contract.md §6.3.
populate: invariants[]: 1 entry per inferred invariant — {id (vd INV-CRM-001-01), req_id_ref (REQ-CRM-001), kind=precondition|postcondition|invariant, expression, severity=MUST|SHOULD|MAY, modules_involved[], source_doc, source_docs_extended[], verified_by[], inferred_by, status=proposed|accepted|rejected|stale, approver, approved_at}
invariants[].inferred_by: {skill='wf-cmi', session_id, pass=1|2|3, agent (vd business-analyst, logistics-expert), domain, confidence ∈ [0,1], evidence[]}
cross_module_dependencies[]: 1 entry per cross-module dep — {id (CMD-CRM-HRM-001), type=FK|event|api-call|cache-shared, from_module, to_module, from_entity, to_entity, inferred_by}
audit_chain.source_registry_checksum: sha256(req-registry.json) tại session time — consumer dùng detect stale
audit_chain.checksum: sha256 của artifact này (self-reference cho integrity check)
DRAFT mode (Phase 3): status='proposed', không có approver/approved_at
CANONICAL mode (Phase 7 sau ACCEPT): status='accepted', có approver=git_user_email, approved_at=ISO 8601
_template_notes.append_mode_note: Canonical sidecar APPEND-only — Phase 7 sync chỉ APPEND invariants mới đã ACCEPT, KHÔNG ghi đè existing entries. Conflict detection qua id+expression checksum.
